name: Council
description: Ask a question in the Council panel: Claude, GPT (Codex) and Gemini (agy) answer blind, a blind Claude chair judges, and you watch it live in an Orca tab.

cover.alt: Four fluted stone heads on columns: three members facing a taller fourth head whose eyes are covered by a stone band, the blind chair

screenshots.alt: The Council tab in Orca after a council: the verdict with what needs you, then Claude, GPT and Gemini's answers and the blind chair
screenshots.caption: The verdict, then each member's answer and the chair
